blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CBI's investigative powers within a state's territory are dependent on obtaining state consent.
The agency frequently faces allegations regarding political interference and lack of operational autonomy.
Heavy investigative workloads cause substantial delays in processing and closing cases.
The requirement of state consent for CBI investigations is a frequent topic in polity exams.
Administrative challenges such as heavy workload delays and allegations of political bias are crucial points for mains analysis.
